bio: FamilySearch places John H. Jones, born about 1879 in Pennsylvania, in Plymouth Ward 1 in 1910, 1920 and 1930, as husband of the widowed Catherine A. (Murphy) McAvoy ([R4-S1]). He was roughly 19 years younger than his wife. No record ties him to Edward F. Jones's family.
